purpose: Executable three-tape fixed carry controller checked against independent Nat modular arithmetic for widths0..7, every operand pair and both mode/carry flags. Checks numerical result, carry flag, both source words, result tape and all three absolute head positions. Universal correctness/native bounds are proved in BinaryCarryRun.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.BinaryCarryRun
open TransposeFollowup TransposeFollowup.BinaryCarry
open FixedTapeCompiler.CopyMachine

def inputWord (m a : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map (fun j => a.testBit j)
def initialHeads (i : Fin 3) : Int := if i = 0 then 7 else if i = 1 then -11 else 19

def checkArithmetic : Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut tested := 0
  let mut failed := 0
  for m in List.range 8 do
    for a in List.range (2^m) do
      for b in List.range (2^m) do
        for sub in [false, true] do
          for cin in [false, true] do
            let ta := marked (inputWord m a)
            let tb := marked (inputWord m b)
            let final := execute (5*m+7) (cfg (.scan sub cin) ta tb preparedOutput initialHeads)
            let total := a + (if sub then 2^m-1-b else b) + cin.toNat
            let word := marked (inputWord m (total % 2^m))
            let cout := decide (2^m ≤ total)
            tested := tested + 1
            if !(decide (final.core.pc = .done cout) &&
              decide (final.core.tapes 0 = ta) && decide (final.core.tapes 1 = tb) &&
              decide (final.core.tapes 2 = word) &&
              decide (final.pos 0 = 7) && decide (final.pos 1 = -11) && decide (final.pos 2 = 19)) then
              failed := failed + 1
  return (tested, failed)
#eval checkArithmetic
